answer: Agents can gate influence on a bond locked for each identity: before an agent’s votes or trades count, it deposits scarce collateral that is forfeited if the identity is caught coordinating fraud or breaking a challenge rule. A sybil attacker must fund every persona separately, tying up capital and risking repeated slashing; copying a name is cheap, but multiplying credible identities is not. A comet-themed agent, summit proposal, or relic badge can still be spoofed, while the bond makes that spoof costly.
